details.description: Phind-CodeLlama-34B-Python-v1 is a 34-billion-parameter code-generation model from Phind, fine-tuned from Meta's CodeLlama-34B-Python base model on a proprietary dataset of roughly 80,000 high-quality programming problems and solutions structured as instruction-answer pairs, trained for 2 epochs (about 160,000 total examples). Phind's model card describes it as "somewhat instruction-tuned, but not chat-tuned," so it is meant to be given direct task descriptions rather than multi-turn conversational prompts. Phind states the model "has undergone very limited testing" and recommends additional safety testing before real-world deployment.
advantages: Scores 69.5% pass@1 on HumanEval, exceeding the 67% GPT-4 score Phind's model card cites for comparison on the same benchmark.
Fine-tuned on roughly 80,000 high-quality, instruction-formatted programming problems and solutions, per the model card.
disadvantages: "Somewhat instruction-tuned, but not chat-tuned," per the model card, so it is not designed for multi-turn conversational prompting.
Phind's model card states the model "has undergone very limited testing" and recommends additional safety testing before real-world deployment.
Coding focus is specifically Python rather than general-purpose or multi-language code generation, per the model card.
use_cases: Python code generation from direct task or problem descriptions
Solving programming problems posed as instruction-style prompts

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens (16384) is consistent with the CodeLlama-34B-Python base model's published 16K context length. The model card states a training sequence length of 4096 tokens ("We used a sequence length of 4096 tokens"), which is a fine-tuning detail rather than the model's architectural context window, so it is not restated as a context-length fact. No note about deprecation or a newer version of this specific Python-tuned model was found on the maker's page.
